rules.port_coordinate_scope: PI/PO node XY may move; identities remain fixed.
rules.objective: Reduce actual routed bounding area and exported QCA cells; both non-increasing, one strictly improved. Distinguish node-box proxy from actual routed area.
rules.routing_execution: One executor-derived complete order after moves; no portfolio fallback.
rules.search_contract: Return a direct gate proposal with routing_order=null; the compiler derives and logs one order using exactly the same rule as the deterministic control. All area/device, exploration, graph identity, clock and physical constraints remain enforced.
rules.proposal_contract: Model synthesizes internal gate coordinates; routing_order=null; executor derives the disclosed deterministic order after placement.
rules.geometry_guidance: Inspect the shared gate-geometry hints as possible starting moves. You may combine or adapt them, or propose new coordinates. Do not repeat a failed geometry merely by swapping the edge list. Use a smaller displacement or a different node subset when routing fails. If moving ports is permitted and they set the outer box, coordinate their relocation with internal gates. Swapping unrelated distant nodes often creates detours; give it a concrete geometric justification.

proposal.rationale: The current layout has vertical congestion around y=26–31 with overlapping fanin paths (e.g., edge [4,10] detour=10, [10,12] detour=2). Moving nodes 10,11,12 down by 2 tiles aligns them with the vacancy hotspot at y=24–26 (window_21_27_23_29), reducing Manhattan detours. Nodes 13,15,16 shift down by 2 to preserve fanout geometry to output 3 while exploiting empty band at x=25–27, y=30–32 (window_21_27_31_37). This contracts height from 18→16 tiles (y_min=20, y_max=35) without moving ports, preserving PI/PO envelope width=9; area reduces from 162→144 tiles. All moves respect neighbor anchors and avoid collisions.

Four coordinated moves contract the vertical extent by 2 tiles (y_max from 37→35) without moving input ports, directly exploiting vacancy hotspots at y=27–30 (window_21_27_27_29 and window_25_27_27_30). Nodes 13,15,16 shift down by 2 to align with empty band x=25–27,y=27–29 and reduce detour on edges [12,13], [12,15], [13,16]. Output node 3 moves down to y=35, preserving fanout geometry to 15 and 16 while eliminating the topmost tile row. All moved nodes remain collision-free; the new bounding box is min_x=20, max_x=28, min_y=20, max_y=35 → width=9, height=16, area=144 tiles, a strict improvement over current 162. Edge manhattan costs are preserved or reduced; no internal node is left unmoved.
